card.name: Digits inside numbers in doses and data
card.fires_on: A single digit (2, 0, 4, 5, 3) in the middle of a multi-digit number or decimal, such as 60, 7.5, 40 or 125. It appears in dose amounts, section numbers and chemistry or science data.

modes.label: Dose numbers
modes.description: Digit inside a dose amount just before a unit like mcg or mg.

modes.label: Decimal after a point
modes.description: Digit right after the decimal point in values like 7.5.
modes.example: Buprenorphine transdermal system doses of 7.<<5>> mcg/hour, 10

modes.label: Science reference data
modes.description: Digit inside atomic or physical figures and electron configurations.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number, mostly doses and measurements, when the number is not yet finished.
